sub_sector.value: Clay cat litter; specialty sorbents; mineral feed additives

manufacturing_type.detail: Mines and processes calcium bentonite, attapulgite and diatomaceous shale into specialty sorbent products.

production_model.detail: Ships packaged Cat’s Pride and private-label litter to distributors and retail partners.

product_complexity.detail: Develops lightweight clumping litter, adsorbents optimized for contaminant removal and filterability, and mineral feed additives.

production_role.detail: Makes branded and private-label litter, produces specialty mineral sorbents, and supplies mineral feed additives.

end_market_exposure.detail: Pet care, lawn and garden, industrial absorbents, fluids purification, animal nutrition, agriculture, automotive, renewable diesel, professional turf and sports fields.

notes: Make-to-stock is inferred from shipments of packaged products to distributors and retailers.
